items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: We worked together recently, he and Gerry Wiggins and I.

ctx.x: She's studying with Dave Koonce. He's a marvelous musician. We worked together recently, he and Gerry Wiggins and I. Gerry Wiggins and I and Harold Jones worked with Buddy Collette last night. When I left home, I was really exhausted, but Gerry brings me to life, just listening to him play.
